newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai tax revenue in 1996 up 25.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai tax revenue in 1996 up 25.6 percent.

text.p: Shanghai produced a record 55.55 billion yuan in tax revenue in 1996, an increase of 25.6 percent over the previous year, the official Xinhua news agency reported on Wednesday.

The agency quoted Zhou Youdao, director of the Shanghai Municipal Finance Bureau, as saying the growth of revenue from the city had surpassed the growth rate in the city's gross domestic product (GDP) for three successive years.
Tax income from private and individual enterprises accounted for 2.2 billion yuan, up by 28 percent on 1995, it added.
